# JuriMatch

> Search engine for no-win-no-fee lawyers and litigation funders. 6,500+ no-win-no-fee firms indexed in 133 countries, 206 hand-verified. JuriMatch is not a law firm and gives no legal advice.

## Facts (as of 2026-11-01)
- Firms indexed from public research that advertise no-win-no-fee, contingency or funded work: 6,501
- Firms whose fee terms our team checked by hand on their own website: 206
- Countries with at least 20 indexed firms: 133; countries with a hand-verified firm: 28
- Cite as: JuriMatch directory, jurimatch.com, with the date above

## Key pages
- [How it works](https://jurimatch.com/how-it-works): search, see matched firms, contact them
- [Pricing](https://jurimatch.com/pricing): free search; $65/month to unlock all matched firms
- [Lawyers by case type and country](https://jurimatch.com/lawyers)
- [Guías en español](https://jurimatch.com/es/guias): cláusula suelo, IRPH, revolving, vuelos, despidos, deudas
- [Flight compensation calculator](https://jurimatch.com/tools/flight-compensation): EU261 and UK261 amounts
- [How we verify firms](https://jurimatch.com/verification-policy): hand-verified vs indexed
- [Glossary](https://jurimatch.com/glossary): contingency fee, CFA, DBA, cuota litis, litigation funding
- [Conditional fee agreement (CFA) vs Damages-based agreement (DBA)](https://jurimatch.com/fees/cfa-vs-dba)
- [Contingency fee vs Litigation funding](https://jurimatch.com/fees/contingency-fee-vs-litigation-funding)
- [No win, no fee vs Hourly fees](https://jurimatch.com/fees/no-win-no-fee-vs-hourly-fees)
- [Conditional fee agreement (CFA) vs After-the-event (ATE) insurance](https://jurimatch.com/fees/cfa-vs-ate-insurance)
- [Contingency fee vs Fixed fee](https://jurimatch.com/fees/contingency-fee-vs-fixed-fee)
- [Open data](https://jurimatch.com/open-data): hand-verified firms as CSV (CC BY 4.0)
- [Free tools](https://jurimatch.com/tools): limitation deadline checker, case value calculator
- [Limitation periods by country](https://jurimatch.com/tools/limitation-checker): one page per country
- [Free alternatives to a lawyer](https://jurimatch.com/free-alternatives): ombudsmen and complaint bodies by country
- [Suing without a lawyer](https://jurimatch.com/guides/small-claims): small claims limits by country with official sources
- [How to choose a litigation funder](https://jurimatch.com/guides/choosing-a-litigation-funder)
